headline: Discussed draft ASTE educational specifications for the proposed new Wallingford High School; feedback will go to consultants before the final document returns for approval.
summary: Public comment on the draft ASTE educational specifications covered course names, program descriptions, facility features, FFA, and the garden. No vote was taken, and Ms. Bellizzi will forward the feedback to the consultants. The finalized document will need approval as part of a grant application.
